# .

> Sourdough bakes four of the five Wayne State app shapes: raw PHP, Laravel + Blade, Laravel + Blade + Vue islands and Laravel + Inertia/Vue, each with SESAME sign-in, HELMET headers, PROCTOR, Preflight CI and Squire's deploy files already in it.

Every page below is Markdown. The HTML pages send the same Markdown to a client that asks for `text/markdown`. Written by Squire's agent-ready kit from the README and the pages; do not edit.

## Pages

- [Sourdough: Feed it and it grows.](https://sourdough.apps.wayne.edu/index.md): Sourdough bakes four of the five Wayne State app shapes: raw PHP, Laravel + Blade, Laravel + Blade + Vue islands and Laravel + Inertia/Vue, each with SESAME sign-in, HELMET headers, PROCTOR, Preflight CI and Squire's deploy files already in it.
- [Agent ready | Sourdough docs](https://sourdough.apps.wayne.edu/docs/agent-ready.md): How the Sourdough site serves coding agents: Markdown twins, llms.txt and the two prompts for your agent.
- [Changelog | Sourdough docs](https://sourdough.apps.wayne.edu/docs/changelog.md): All notable changes to this project.
- [Overview | Sourdough docs](https://sourdough.apps.wayne.edu/docs/index.md): What Sourdough bakes: install, flags, permutations, plans, the manifest and the checks.
- [Maintaining | Sourdough docs](https://sourdough.apps.wayne.edu/docs/maintaining.md): How to build, test, release and keep Sourdough alive: the commands, CI, the smoke gate and the release steps.

## Prompts

- [Get started with Sourdough](https://sourdough.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-get-started): Installs Sourdough, makes a raw PHP app with WayneUI, serves it locally and runs the manifest check. The prompt itself is in https://sourdough.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
- [Check what has drifted in a Sourdough app](https://sourdough.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-manifest): Lists the managed files that changed since Sourdough wrote them and suggests what to put back. It changes nothing. The prompt itself is in https://sourdough.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.

## Source

- [README](https://nougat.snu.gs/enterprise-apps/sourdough/blob/HEAD/README.md): the project's README, with install, commands and checks
- [Everything in one file](https://sourdough.apps.wayne.edu/llms-full.txt): the README and every page above, as one Markdown file

- [ADVISOR](https://advisor.apps.wayne.edu/llms.txt): the stack's MCP server: read-only tools that answer from CREED's policy and the parts' docs instead of from memory
- [WELD](https://weld.apps.wayne.edu/llms.txt): the Wayne State application stack: every part, and the reference app
